notes.title: Beta 0.8
notes.content:
Beta 0.8

Boss Long Toe now has a Fire vulnerability and Earth resistance.

Boss Blood Bat is now immune to Poison.

Enemy Guardians now have Earth immunity, Water vulnerability and Wind vulnerability.
Enemy Guardians now have an MP cost rate of 0%, allowing them to use skill Wall of Stone.

Enemy Minotaurs now have Fire vulnerability.
Enemy Minotaurs now use skill Maul.

Enemy Tomb Stoned now have Wind vulnerability.

Enemy Awoobis now have Fire vulnerability.
Enemy Awoobis now use skill Heal and Drink Potion.

Enemy Green Knights now have Fire and Lightning vulnerability, and Earth and Water resistance.

Enemy Spear Skeletons now have Darkness immunity.

Enemy Zombies now have Darkness resistance.

Enemy Church Henchmen now have Lightning vulnerability.
Enemy Church Henchmen now use skill Drink Potion.
Enemy Church Henchmen have had their MAT increased to 50.

Enemy Drakonian Warriors now have Fire resistance and Water vulnerability.

Character Long Toe now has a Fire vulnerability and Earth resistance.

Character Frankumstain now has Light vulnerability and Darkness Immunity.

The player can no longer attempt to re-recruit Long Toe, Flame Face or King Ssnak if they already have them.

The animations associated with the slide in Probable Destruction and the minecart in Instant Disintegration have been improved.

notes.title: Beta 0.7
notes.content:
Beta 0.7

New Idle Conversation system now in effect when entering world map.

Stone and Gold outfits are now available for all boss characters in the Overworld Realms and Transinvalleya. They are available at their statues.

Most magic enemies now only use Drink Potion when below 25% magic.

Trolls now use Yeet! skill.

Gnolls now only use Maul skill when below half health.

Frankumstain's horses now use nuzzle.

Boss Long Toe has been nerfed and is now beatable at level 10.

Boss Flameface's health has been increase to 7500.

Boss Gram Stroker has been nerfed and is now beatable at level 10.
Boss Gram Stroker will now only uses Drink Potion when below 25% magic.

Boss Blood Bat has been nerfed and is now beatable at level 10.

Boss Vera no longer uses Drink Potion.

New shield Bone Shield added. Drops from Spear Skeletons.
New sword Boner added. Drops from Spear Skeletons.

New accessory Dimensional Fabric added. Dropped from Lol Lmao.

New accessory Mind Control Device added. Dropped from Frankumstain's Horses.

Vera's Blade now applies Bleed instead of Poison.

Cars can now unlock the ability to use shields.

New skill Disassemble available for Mechanics.

New skill Dispell available for Mages and Healers.

Maul skill now scales off of ATK and DEF, which was the original intention.

Chests in Castle Isene, Crogior's Tower and Under the Waterfall have had their sprite changed.

Gnolls have been added to the map of Crogior's Tower.

The shelves of wine in the Mage Cave have been given inspect lines for Nekro, Trolgar, Miss Handler, Marge, Cars, Mordred and Vera.

The bloody car outside Marge's dealership now has an inspect line for Vera.

The ice crystals Under the Waterfall now have inspect lines for Nekro, Mordred, Isene and Miss Handler.

Bnuy's Hotel now displays cost properly.

The Nallont Forest now has a rain effect.

The slide in Probable Destruction has been given an interaction.
The cum pool has been given an alternative entrance.
Signs have been added for the outfit store, Hero's old house and Pumpcoomhead's hotel.

Three chests have been added to the Troll Cave in the Overworld Realms.

New music tracks have been added for Nallant Forest, Castle Isene, Crogior's Tower, Under the Waterfall and Castle Trolgar.

The game has been given a unique menu theme.

notes.title: Beta 0.6
notes.content:
Beta 0.6

Mithril Axe now has its animation assigned.

Fur Coat now grants immunity to Shocked.

Staff of Isene now grants 50% bonus Ice damage instead of enabling the Icicles skill.

Holy Helm now plays an ominous bell toll when equipped.

Gold tier weapons and armor now play a special sound when equipped.

New Yeet skill now available to Heroes and Warriors.

New Bolt skill now available to Mages.

New Battlecry skill now available to Heroes and Warriors.

New Venomous Bite skill now available to King Ssnak.

New Brawler passive available to Heroes.

Fire skill now removes Countering state.

Break skill now removes Countering state.

Flame Face character is now immune to Burn.
Flame Face character now has Fire absoption instead of immunity.

Cesare character is now immune to Blind.

Frankumstain character is now immune to Shocked.

Furry Humpman character now has Fire vulnerability and Ice resistance.

Queen Isene character now has Ice immunity and Fire vulnerability.

Vyrilock character now has Fire resistance, Burn immunity and Water vulnerability.
Vyrilock character is now Hero class, but will have Axes unlocked when recruited.
Vyrilock character now has unique Fire Breath skill.
-No other character currently has access to this skill.

King Ssnak character now has Fire vulnerability.

Pumpcoomhead character now has 5% health regen.

Frankumstain boss now uses Bolt, Yeet and Scratch.
Frankumstain boss now has MP regeneration.
Frankumstain boss is now immune to Shocked.

Grand Stroker boss now uses Blood Splash.

Flame Face boss is now immune to Burn.

Vyrilock boss is now immune to Burn.

Angry Cesare boss now uses Battlecry and Yeet.
Angry Cesure boss is now immune to Blind.

Queen Isene boss now uses Freeze.

Frankumstain's horses now have light vulnerability and darkness immunity.

King Ssnak boss now has fire vulnerability.
King Ssnak boss now uses Venomous Bite.

Galaxy Black Dragon boss now has Darkness resistance.
Galaxy Black Dragon boss's ATK, DEF, MAT and MDF have been reduced by 50.

Guardians now use Wall of Stone.

Inside Out Giraffes now use Blood Splash instead of Fire.

Windigoes now have Wind resistance and Fire vulnerability.

The Hotel in northern Overworld Realms now has scaling cost.
Pumpcoomhead's Hotel now has scaling cost.
Dee's Inn(from both Dee herself and her chicken plushie) now has scaling cost.
The Inns on both Floor 7 and 11 now have scaling cost.

Isene's Castle has been slightly redecorated.
-The bed has new inspect lines for Nekro, Miss Handler and Isene.
-The dresser has new inspect lines for Nekro, Miss Handler, Isene and Trolgar.
-The dinner table has new inspect lines for Nekro, Isene and Mordred.
-The mirror has new inspect lines for Nekro, Miss Handler, Isene, Trolgar and Cars.

The Troll Cave has been expanded.

The Grave in Overworld Realms now has a readable plaque.

The innkeeper of the tent inn has been replaced.
-The inn itself has several new interactables.

The cum lake in the Overworld Realms now has inspect lines for Nekro, Cars and Miss Handler.

DOTs and floor damage can now knockout.

Vyrilock Statue should now work properly.

The Helicopter in the City in Overworld Realms is now usable.
The edge of the lake in the City is now walkable.

An outfit shop has been added to the Town of Probable Destruction.

notes.title: Beta 0.5
notes.content:
Beta 0.5

Blood Bat boss now uses Blood Splash skill.
-His MP cost rate has been lowered to 0%.

Stick of Blood now uses Blood Splash and Drink Potion skills.

New Blood Splash skill now available to Mages.

A snow effect has been added around Isene's Castle.

Snowy hills are now flagged as bushes.

Some remaining map enemies have been slowed down.

The abandoned diamonds in the Slayer Pit now has inspect lines for Nekro, Isene, Marge and Mordred.

The broken mirror in Slayer Pit now has inspect lines for Nekro and Marge.

The log in Slayer Pit now has inspect lines for Nekro and Crogior.

The rope in the Slayer Pit now has inspect lines for Nekro and Mordred.

The shovel in the Slayer Pit now has inspect lines for Nekro and Miss Handler.

The broken clock now has an inspect line.

Duplicate magic menu from Grammy's Gratifier has been removed.

notes.title: Beta 0.4
notes.content:
Beta 0.4

In-game Patchnotes have been disabled due to unforeseen issues.

Equip menu has been replaced.
-Optimize function has been removed.
-Characters can now wear two different accessories.

Attack stats have been increased for most classes.

Vyrilock has been nerfed to standard boss levels.

Dragons Riders' Experience and Monies have been nerfed to standard enemy levels.

Most standard bosses have been slightly nerfed.

Grand Stroker and King Ssnak have been slightly buffed.

Frankumstain's Horse no longer inflict poison. This was a holdover from when their role was taken by snakes.

New Wind skill now avilable to Mages.

Vampire Bite skill is now categorized as magic, but still scales off of physical stats.

Target rate increase from Vanguard has been increased to 300%.

Helper icons have been added to the descriptions of all weapons and armor.

New Dragon Reins weapon added. Dropped by Dragon Riders.

Granny's Gratifier now gives +50% experience.

Frankumstain's Lightning Rods are now considered a headpiece.

The Frozen Blade now gives +50% critrate.

Crogior's Windblade now attacks twice.

The Rock Hammer now deals Earth damage.

Fur Coat is now considered a lightarmor body. It was previously a general accessory.

Inner Volcano in the Overworld Realms has been given a battleback, which was unassigned before.

Fiery Demises no longer has random enemy spawns.

The hallway leading to Frankumstain has been widened.

Most enemies on map now move slightly slower.

Wooden bridges in the overworld are now passable.
-Be aware that if you land your balloon on the pier in the town, then walk in town you will need to get a new Balloon.

The Tent Inn in the Overworld Realms now uses a new calculation that scales cost with the number of unlocked characters.
-This function should be tested more before rolling it out to other inns.

notes.title: Beta 0.3
notes.content:
Patchnotes can now be accessed in the title menu.

Added balloon fast travel system.

Skills now have consistent help icons.

Added Event Chase Player.
-Chase Player implemented for most standard enemies.

Slayer has been buffed significantly.

Troll now has 50% resistance against Earth damage.

Furry Humpman now has 300% SP charge rate.
Furry Humpman now has a resistance to Ice damage.

Dark Crusader now has 50% resistance against Light Damage.
Dark Crusador now uses Break and Block skills.

Killer Colors now has 200% weakness to Darkness.

New Freeze skill now available to Mages.

New Maul skill now available to Kitties.
-Furry Humpman now has maul.

New Wall of Stone skill now available to Mages and Healers.

New Pharmacist passive now available to Healers.

Environmentally Friendly Helmet now has a very small health regen.

New Drakonian Blade sword added. Dropped by Drakonian Warriors.

New Magic Mirror accessory added. Dropped by Killer Colors.

New Symbol accessory added. Dropped by Church Henchman.

Damage from Weed and Hotbox now scale with ATK and DEF instead of MAT and MDF.

The inspect lines of the big tree in the Overworld Realms now display names in color.

The inspect lines in the Construction Site now display names in color.
-The drill has been given new inspect lines for Nekro, Trolgar and Marge.
-The barrel has been given newinspect lines for Nekro, Cars and Marge.

Edges of mountains in the Overworld Realms have been altered to appear less jarring.

The floor of the Ice Castle has been replaced.

The Grave dungeon in the Overworld Realms has been revamped.

The Volcano in the Overowlrd Realms have been expanded with a new area.
-New area has four chests.

The Cave of Immediate Harm has been revamped.

A new chest has been added to the Construction site.

Fixed conflict that prevented the player from interacting with and recruiting Marge.

notes.title: Beta 0.2
notes.content:
All useable equipment types now display in the Learn Skills screen.
-Save games from before this update will see characters lose access to their class's base equipment. Buying the correlating passives will fix this.
-New saves will initialize passive skills as intended.

Monies have been made much harder to come by.
-Value of Silver weapons and armor have been cut in half.
-Monies dropped from enemies have been reduced by varying amounts.

Added enemy skill based on the Weed item.
-Currently, Tombstoned and Troll use this skill.

The Weed item now deals Earth damage and is considered a physical attack.

Tombstoned is now immune to Earth damage and the Sleep state.

Added Inspect skill whose function is identical to Scan except in being in the Motor Skills category.
-The text output of Scan and Inspect now properly refer to SP. It referred to it as TP before.

Mechanics can now buy the Inspect skill.
Mages can now buy the Icicles skill and the Swords passive.
Cars can now buy the Heavy Armor passive.

Dee's line when inspecting the barrel of nuts in her Inn has been changed.

The plaque on Dee's Inn now displays her name in her color.

The tied rope in the Flamin Tiddies Stripclub now has inspect lines for Miss Handler and Mordred.

Every character now has a short description found in their status menu.

The descriptions of several enemies have been updated.
